card.name: Step boundaries in injection instructions
card.fires_on: Sentence ends, step numbers, dashes and the first word of a new step in how-to instructions for injecting or preparing a drug. It fires where the next instruction step is about to begin.

modes.label: Step breaks
modes.description: Period, dash or step number that ends one injection step and starts the next.
